excerpts.content: <@1035747431461167125> What did you guys do for the equivocation setting post fulu?   do you broadcast datacolumn sidecars early just like sidecars in electra/deneb?

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: do you mean broadcast data sidecars before block? we do it the other way around as other nodes can pull data via get_blobs engine api

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: I pushed some updates, based on feedback so far I kept `block_id` as filter

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content: yeah, doing it the other way around? as in no longer needs to broadcast data sidecars first if equivocation check passes?

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: which equivoction check, on gossip? we changed the order to block first hen `getBlobsV1` was adopted on mainnet

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content:
https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/?urls.primaryName=dev#/Beacon/publishBlockV2 this one 
consensus_and_equivocation: the same as consensus, with an extra equivocation check immediately before the block is broadcast. If the block is found to be an equivocation it fails validation.

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: that one is not used by default, but wouldn't you check that first, no matter your publishing order

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content:
yeah so after the consensus/equivocation checks does your order change ( ours still does sidecar first if it is an equivocated block) 
also as a side question do you guys do verification on the blobs for gossip or consensus or both?

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: hmm if any `broadcast_validation` fails you shouldn't be publishing at all, or do you mean you just publish sidecars?

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content:
> also as a side question do you guys do verification on the blobs for gossip or consensus or both?
for gossip we only run gossip checks on the block, consensus checks everything
